name: WF-06 — Lead Capture → Odoo CRM
description: Captures leads from FB Lead Ads, website forms, or Telegram → creates contact in Odoo → triggers follow-up
trigger: Facebook Lead Ad webhook OR website form webhook OR Telegram /newlead
steps: 1. Webhook trigger (FB Lead Ad / form submission)
2. Parse: name, email, phone, source, interest
3. Create lead in Odoo CRM via JSONRPC (model: crm.lead)
4. Assign to salesperson (round-robin or by area)
6. Send Telegram alert to sales team with lead details
